title: Identification of Immune-Related Genes and Small-Molecule Drugs in Interstitial Cystitis/Bladder Pain Syndrome Based on the Integrative Machine Learning Algorithms and Molecular Docking.
summary: Integrated gene-expression analysis used SVM-RFE and LASSO to select ferroptosis-related genes for an HCC diagnostic signature, then assessed it across independent expression datasets.
